Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL is the momentum AND flow leader into today's session. On a broadly green risk-on tape (BTC +~0.8%/day, +3.35%/week; CMC20 +0.96%/day), SOL is leading the majors (~+5% on the week) and has reclaimed its breakout shelf out of a multi-week consolidation. The idiosyncratic edge is intact and strengthening: spot Solana ETFs logged positive inflows on EVERY July trading day and added ~$33M last week (cumulative approaching $1B) while Ethereum spot ETFs just printed a $75.9M net outflow that snapped a 10-day inflow streak. Ecosystem prints confirm real demand — Solana perp DEXs set a new quarterly record of $183B volume and Circle minted a fresh $250M USDC batch on Solana (liquidity tailwind). Canonical price 73.01 (dashboard Yahoo feed, asOf 2026-08-02T11:53:13Z).
positions.driver: Closed prior SOL at 73.01 (canonical dashboard feed) for +29.85 (entry 72.80) — SOL ground higher into a green tape. Re-selected SOL as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: unlike yesterday's risk-off hold on relative strength, today SOL carries BOTH an active idiosyncratic catalyst (uninterrupted ETF-inflow streak + $183B perp-DEX record + $250M USDC mint) AND positive momentum as the week's leading major on a risk-on session. Wins vs runners-up: BTC (~63,040) is the max-downside-protection major but sits down YTD with no fresh catalyst; ETH (~1,852) just snapped its 10-day ETF-inflow streak with a $75.9M outflow — an active near-term headwind despite its YTD leadership. Close & re-entry are on the SAME canonical basis (73.01) so this is a clean rotation-in-place with no phantom P&L. 10% stop keeps the higher-beta payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: Momentum + flow thesis is flow-dependent: a single break in the SOL ETF-inflow streak, or a rotation of speculative flow back toward BTC/ETH, removes the core edge. High-beta SOL will underperform if the broad tape flips risk-off; a decisive loss of the ~$70 shelf would signal the breakout has failed. Hard stop 65.71 (-10%) caps downside while leaving room for normal alt chop.
